text:
morgan: Quick heads-up — PR #42077 is queued for merge but I need cross-team sign-offs before the canary. It touches runtime eviction heuristics, an infra kube annotation, and a small auth header change that security should glance at. Can the following teams please weigh in: runtime (alex), infra (carmen), security (li)?

alex: saw the PR earlier, skimmed the runtime bits — logic looks sane but want a quick perf sanity check on long-seq cases. Can you paste the perf run you used? :eyes:

morgan: thanks. perf command I used:```./scripts/run_perf.sh --model=gptx --seq=8192 --batch=8 --iters=20``` Results in ~12% tail improvement on our staging runner. I can repro and add the raw csv if that helps.

carmen: I can look at the kube annotation change. Quick question: does this require a new admission-controller exception? If so we need SRE/infra rollout notes.

morgan: no new admission rules, just a pod annotation to tweak eviction priority. Will include rollout steps in the PR description (and a patch to the infra-runbooks).

li: I'll skim the auth header bit. If it's just a header rename we need to ensure telemetry still picks up the request IDs. If it touches token parsing, that's higher risk.

morgan: it's a small rename + a fallback to accept legacy header for one week. Not touching token parsing. I'll add an explicit migration log and a toggle.

sam: FYI — retention/console side may need a short note because cost dashboards pick up the new annotation. I can file a brief docs blurb once changes land.

tanvi: can we schedule the canary for tomorrow morning (UTC)? I have capacity to monitor the route 09:00–11:00 UTC. If runtime and infra give :+1: before EOD I'll queue it.

alex: will run the longer perf job and post outputs by 16:30 UTC. If numbers hold, :+1: from runtime.

carmen: I'll validate the convoy of infra checks and admission-free rollout plan. Expecting to confirm by 17:00 UTC.

li: glancing now. If I see anything weird I'll comment inline. Otherwise will approve security by 17:30.

deploy-bot: Reminder — merge window policy requires at least one approver from each of runtime, infra, security and a canary owner before auto-merge. See /policies/merge-windows.

morgan: perfect — thanks all. I'll update the PR with the perf csv, the rollout steps, and the migration toggle. Ping me in-thread when you approve so I can schedule the canary. :rocket:
